---
title: "Annotation markers in a literal block"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

A Markdown block shows an annotated R block as text.
Markdown comments are `<!--` and `-->`, so `# <1>` is not a marker here.

````markdown
```r
x <- 1 # <1>
```

1. Assign one.
````

An annotated R block still gets its annotation.

```r
y <- 2 # <1>
```

1. Assign two.
